subject: can i Use clickId - plotOutput in a Heatmap?

messages.author: 76e101ce83bfedbb
messages.subject: can i Use clickId - plotOutput in a Heatmap?
parts:
Hi,

I'm trying to get the plot coordinates using clickId but it seems give me are the coordinates of the area where this plot Built

should i build my heatmap in other package to get the coordinates of the plot using clickId?


SERVER.R

library(shiny)

shinyServer(function(input, output) {
  
  output$myworld <- renderPlot({
    require(graphics); require(grDevices)
    x  <- as.matrix(mtcars)
    
    heatmap(x, Rowv = NA, Colv = NA, scale = "column",
            main = "heatmap(*, NA, NA) ~= image(t(x))")
    
  })
  output$clickcoord <- renderPrint({
    print(input$plotclick)
  })
})

UI.R

shinyUI(pageWithSidebar(
  
  # Application title
  headerPanel("My App"),
  sidebarPanel(
    textOutput("clickcoord")
  ),
  
  # Show a plot of the generated distribution
  mainPanel(
    plotOutput("myworld", height="600px", clickId="plotclick")
  )
))

Thanks 


Natalia
